answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, no identity may audit its own recruit. Work waits on the mirror until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the onyx of the next round. Reaching the ivory of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
